newsitem.title: POLAND: Farm mkt share seen up to 15 pct in 2000.
newsitem.headline: Farm mkt share seen up to 15 pct in 2000.

text.p: The Polish meat processing firm Farm Food SA is likely to increase its market share to between 10 and 15 percent in 2000 from the current four percent, IB Austria Securities Warsaw SA said in a report dated December 4.
It said the new, up to 600,000 rights issue, to be carried out early next year, was expected to bring funds to help increase the firm's production capacity and promote its trademark.
"Farm Food is one of the newest and the most modern food processing firm in Poland. It has a several times bigger operating margin than most of its competitors," it said.
Farm Food's operating margin was at 11.3 percent last year. IB Austria saw it falling to 10.4 percent this year and nine percent in 1997.
It expected Farm Food's net profit to rise to 9.9 million zlotys in 1997 and 14.2 million in 1998, up from 9.1 million expected in 1996.
It saw its sales growing to 244.7 million in 1997 and 283.9 million in 1998, up from 203.9 million expected in 1996.
On Monday Farm Food closed at 39.5 zlotys.
